INSERT INTO submission_cases (submission_id, case_ordinal, status, time_used_ms, memory_used_kb, message) VALUES
(#{item.submissionId}, #{item.caseOrdinal}, #{item.status}, #{item.timeUsedMs}, #{item.memoryUsedKb}, #{item.message})
